verdict.rationale: Phaser is a game framework with a companion Scene Editor, so version-control and team-workflow support is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never documents mergeable scene files, diffable text project formats, Git integration, or built-in multi-user collaboration. Mentions that development uses JavaScript/TypeScript and that project files can be moved to VS Code don't establish a documented version-control or collaboration capability.

support.subject: As a studio lead, the project format and tooling play well with version control and multi-person teams — mergeable scenes, diffable text formats, or built-in collaboration
